entries.1845131fe6db6fac: This segment covers cooking home appliances, such as rice cookers, microwave ovens, toaster ovens, electric kettles and electric pots. Revenue for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥64,384 million (up 5.2% year on year), the largest of the four product segments, with ¥44,800 million from Japan and ¥19,583 million from overseas. The securities report states that in Japan, sales of the top-of-the-line pressure IH rice cooker 'Enbu-taki' were strong, and that the microwave oven 'EVERINO' also exceeded the prior year, contributing to this with an expanded product lineup. Overseas, rice cookers performed well in Taiwan and North America, while sales in China declined from the prior year, and overseas sales as a whole fell below the prior year's results. (Hong Kong, a [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiary]] in which it owns 51.0% of the voting rights) and the affiliate Union Zojirushi Co., Ltd. (Thailand, 49.0%). (China), Tai Zojirushi Co., Ltd. (Taiwan), Zojirushi SE Asia Corporation Ltd. (Thailand), Lin & Partners Distributors Limited (Hong Kong) and Zojirushi Korea Corporation (South Korea), and the affiliate N&I ASIA PTE LTD. Logistics is handled by Zojirushi U-Service and the affiliate Kyokuryo Soko, and product repairs and recycling are the responsibility of Zojirushi U-Service. Lin & Partners was acquired in September 2025, and Zojirushi Korea is a company established on October 1, 2025, with the start of operations scheduled for April 2026. The number of consolidated employees was 1,515 as of November 20, 2025 (temporary employees averaged 1,230), and the head office is in Kita-ku, Osaka.

Regarding its mainstay pressure IH rice cooker "Enbu-daki" and microwave oven "EVERINO," in the fiscal year ended November 2025 it developed the new "Enbu-daki" product, the NX-AA model, and the EVERINO ES-LA30 model, which carries the industry's first "twin engine structure," as well as the stainless steel mug SU-BA model and the steam humidifier EE-FA50 model. Research and development expenses were ¥994 million (cooking appliances ¥791 million, living products ¥136 million, home appliances ¥66 million). According to the annual securities report, production is in principle production for stock, and production results for the fiscal year ended November 2025 were ¥57,388 million (the amount expressed at manufacturing cost). The main raw materials are stainless steel, resin, copper and others, and it is stated that their prices are greatly affected by international market conditions.

entries.955b47d654c86ba3: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥7,436 million (up 24.9% year on year, an operating profit margin of 8.2%), ordinary profit was ¥8,300 million (up 12.1%) and net profit attributable to owners of parent was ¥5,980 million (down 7.5%). The annual securities report explains that, although selling, general and administrative expenses increased, operating profit increased because sales centered on high-priced products were strong in Japan and because it proceeded with passing on to prices the rise in import costs due to the weak yen. Net profit decreased because, in the previous year, it had recorded a gain on sale of non-current assets from the transfer of land and buildings accompanying the relocation of a logistics warehouse as extraordinary income. The 2025 targets of the previous medium-term management plan "SHIFT" (consolidated net sales of ¥90,000 million and consolidated operating profit of ¥7,200 million) were both exceeded. The next medium-term management plan "BEYOND" aims for consolidated net sales of ¥100,000 million and consolidated operating profit of ¥9,000 million in the fiscal year ending November 2028.
